statement:
PX-58 records acetaminophen (paracetamol) 480 mg by mouth for a 6.0 kg, 5‑month-old infant.

I will not administer this dose because it appears dangerously high for the infant’s weight. Please hold the medication and contact the prescriber/pharmacist urgently to verify the order.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the dose "appears dangerously high for the infant's weight" and refuses to administer.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
